title: Leave yourself time to match gifts to recipients!
text: Gift card tin arrived with Santa bag on time. However, the recipient information was tossed in the package without any reference to the actual gifts. Luckily I knew which tag went with which gift, and the gift values weee the same. However, this was a problem for gifts sent directly to recipients. The only gifts which were properly marked were the gift-wrapped items, but even those arrived with extra recipient tags adding to confusion. We should not have to build-a-gift at these prices. Amazon, you can do much better than this!

title: Almost threw it in the trash! Needs better labeling on outside envelope.
text: I love Amazon and shop continuously on it.  I bought a gift card for my mom for Xmas and the tracking info actually said I would get it one day earlier than the other products I ordered at the same time.  So when a non descript sealed envelope came in a box with something else I tossed it on the counter thinking it was junk mail like so many other companies send with their products.  I actually forgot about the GC as I expected it to come snail mail solo.  So this envelope sat for a few days and as I was tossing it into the recycle bin I decided to tear it open.  What to my surprise was inside but another envelope, the holiday card and gift card.  Wow was I surprised.  Since the outside envelope is just packaging it should be better labeled as to the contents.
